title: 第一卷 第4章 她竟然要突破紫府境？
content_zh:
那一头的陆承锋在震惊过后，便继续热菜。

    他刚才剁肉，应该是要炖汤。

    陈渊心中这般想着，舔了舔嘴唇，强压下腹中饥饿，再次收心修炼。

    “从凡人体质开始修炼，第一步，需要开启身上的灵窍，引天地灵气入体……”

    “灵窍数量的多少，决定引动天地灵气入体的速度。”

    “之后的修炼步骤，便是汇聚灵气于下丹田。”

    “下丹田，位于脐下一寸三分······”

    “此地……也叫炁海。”

    “炁海，乃是生命炉灶，将灵窍吸纳而来的天地灵力，汇聚于此，点燃炼化，化作法力。”

    “法力流淌四肢百骸，强化肉身，达成炼精化气之效……”

    “这个过程完成，便是——法体境！”

    ……

    陈渊脑海中浮现出，陆承锋昔日教导他修炼的话语，开始引动灵气，流淌四肢百骸，淬炼肉身。

    天地灵气自陈渊身上三百六十一个灵窍······也就是那些气旋，涌入体内，汇聚于炁海。

    灵气在炁海中翻滚、爆发，化作三道旋涡。

    一道漆黑。

    一道赤红。

    还有一道，则是纯白。

    原本被气旋吸入体内的灵气，到了此处，竟自动分为三股。

    一股化作黑气，涌入黑色旋涡。

    一股化作红气，涌入红色旋涡。

    剩下的，则是纯净的白气，涌入白色旋涡。

    “果然……”

    忽然能够内视，陈渊心中一喜！

    这天地灵气被污染了，人族修士无法正常修炼，需要靠丹药来净化魔灵和煞灵。

    但他陈渊的身体，却是可以容纳这些魔灵气与煞灵气。

    甚至是在丹田之处，将他们给分类了。

    常人吸收会被侵蚀肉身，他却毫发无损。

    甚至是，他手掌中的太阳印记和月亮印记，还可以吞噬别人体内的魔灵与煞灵。

    这相当于，是给别人净化了！

    陈渊无法理解，为何会出现这样的情况？

    但毋庸置疑，这是非常逆天的存在。

    让他有足够的信心，在这危机四伏的世界立足。

    ···

    时间缓缓流逝。

    修行之中，陈渊耳畔不时传来隔壁灶房汤水咕嘟咕嘟的声响，阵阵香气飘来，让他再也无法安心修炼。

    从清晨外出，到中午搏杀，回来时已是下午。

    此刻夕阳西斜，血红的月亮缓缓升起。

    青山村依旧一片死寂，无人敢高声言语。

    这里的人情极其冷漠，邻里之间也极少往来。

    可陈渊却是觉得，这间小屋格外温馨。

    虽然有个死后化作僵尸，却仍保留一丝理智的陆大叔······但陈渊依旧觉得温暖。

    至少，这里还有个小财迷，可可爱爱，耍宝卖萌的小糯米。

    “糯米……”

    陈渊曾想过这名字的含义。

    该不会是陆承锋，故意给女儿取名糯米，是用来克制他身上，那类似僵尸一般的邪气吧？

    “阿渊哥，开饭咯。”

    这时，屋外传来糯米兴奋的叫喊，陈渊从思绪中回过神。

    他结束修炼，走出房间，来到厅堂。

    早上的桌子虽已碎裂，陆承锋却不知从哪里又找来一张崭新木桌。

    桌上已摆满十几道菜，大多是陈渊从柳家打包回来的硬菜。

    还多了一锅汤，不知是用何种兽肉熬制而成。
content_en:
Lu Chengfeng on the other end continued to heat the food after being shocked.

    He was chopping meat just now, probably to make soup.

    Chen Yuan thought this in his mind, licked his lips, suppressed the hunger in his stomach, and concentrated on practicing again.

    "Starting from cultivating a mortal body, the first step is to open the spiritual apertures in the body and attract the spiritual energy of heaven and earth into the body..."

    "The number of spiritual orifices determines the speed at which the spiritual energy of heaven and earth enters the body."

    "The next step of cultivation is to gather spiritual energy in the lower dantian."

    "The lower Dantian is located three inches below the navel..."

    "This place... is also called Qihai."

    "Qihai is the furnace of life. The spiritual power of heaven and earth absorbed by the spiritual aperture is gathered here, ignited and refined, and turned into magic power."

    "Mana flows through the limbs and bones, strengthening the body and achieving the effect of refining and transforming Qi..."

    "When this process is completed, we will reach the Dharma Body Realm!"

    …

    In Chen Yuan's mind, Lu Chengfeng's words that taught him how to practice in the past began to arouse spiritual energy, flowing through his limbs and bones, and tempering his physical body.

    The spiritual energy of heaven and earth came from Chen Yuan's 361 spiritual apertures... that is, those cyclones, poured into his body, and gathered in the Qi Sea.

    The spiritual energy rolled and exploded in the sea of ​​​​Qi, turning into three vortexes.

    A ray of darkness.

    A flash of red.

    There is another one, which is pure white.

    The spiritual energy that was originally sucked into the body by the cyclone was automatically divided into three streams when it arrived here.

    A stream of energy turned into black energy and poured into the black vortex.

    A stream of red gas turned into a red vortex.

    The rest is pure white gas, pouring into the white vortex.

    "Sure enough..."

    Suddenly being able to see inside, Chen Yuan felt happy!

    The spiritual energy of this world is polluted, and human monks cannot practice normally. They need to rely on elixirs to purify demonic spirits and evil spirits.

    But Chen Yuan's body can accommodate these demonic and evil spirits.

    They were even classified into categories at the Dantian.

    Ordinary people's bodies would be corroded if absorbed, but he was unscathed.

    Even the sun mark and moon mark in his palm can swallow the demon spirits and evil spirits in other people's bodies.

    This is equivalent to purifying others!

    Chen Yuan couldn't understand why this happened?

    But there is no doubt that this is a very unnatural existence.

    Let him have enough confidence to gain a foothold in this crisis-ridden world.

    ···

    Time passes slowly.

    While practicing, Chen Yuan heard from time to time the sound of gurgling soup from the kitchen next door, and bursts of aroma wafted in, making him unable to practice with peace of mind.

    From going out early in the morning to fighting at noon, it was already afternoon when I came back.

    At this moment, the sun is setting in the west, and the blood-red moon is slowly rising.

    Qingshan Village was still silent, no one dared to speak loudly.

    People here are extremely indifferent and there is very little contact between neighbors.

    But Chen Yuan felt that this cabin was particularly cozy.

    Although there was Uncle Lu who turned into a zombie after death, he still retained a trace of sanity... But Chen Yuan still felt warm.

    At least, there is a little money fan here, a cute little glutinous rice who plays tricks and shows off his cuteness.

    "Glutinous rice..."

    Chen Yuan once thought about the meaning of this name.

    Could it be that Lu Chengfeng deliberately named his daughter Nuomi to restrain his zombie-like evil?

    "Brother A Yuan, let's have dinner."

    At this time, Nuomi's excited shouts came from outside the house, and Chen Yuan came back from his thoughts.

    He finished his practice, walked out of the room, and came to the hall.

    Although the table in the morning was broken into pieces, Lu Chengfeng found a brand new wooden table from nowhere.

    There are more than a dozen dishes on the table, most of which are hard dishes that Chen Yuan packed back from the Liu family.

    There was also a pot of soup, which was made from unknown animal meat.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 4 She actually wants to break through the Purple Mansion Realm?
